zcsdfzfh.variantName: Living and Home 6FT Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with Metal Stand - White
zcsdfzfh.sourceDescription: What makes Christmas moving isn't always the gifts—it's the moment the lights come on. This Christmas tree has full, realistic branches, each tip opening naturally—standing there like a real pine. It doesn't need much decoration; the holiday mood is already there. Even better, it comes with built-in gentle lighting—plug it in and warm light seeps through the branches, brightening and warming the whole room. No stringing lights, no hunting for sockets—the tree carries the season on its own. At home, in the office, or in a shop, it becomes the place people stop at the moment they walk in. It's more than a tree. It's the first light of winter in your home—switch it on, and Christmas is here. Overall Dimension: W82 x D82 x H180cm Recycle your tree through a community program where available. SYL Moda Trading LTD, Po Box 148, Manchester, M266BJ, United Kingdom

vgrvyadc.sourceDescription: Create a spectacular festive centrepiece with this Christow Micro LED Starburst Christmas Tree. Finished in gold and illuminated by hundreds of static warm white micro LEDs, it has a stunning starburst look for an enchanting light display. This 1.8m version is designed for a festive seasonal display. • Starry Warm White Micro LEDs: Coloured gold and illuminated by hundreds of warm white micro LEDs, the tree has a magical starburst look to brighten any setting. • Built-In Timer Function: Enjoy hassle-free festive lighting every evening with a built-in timer function. • Mains Powered with 5m Cable: Powered by an IP20-rated UK transformer plug, the tree is suitable for plugging into an indoor socket only. • Easy Assembly & Outdoor Stability: Simply twist the bottom pole onto the base, then twist the top pole onto the bottom pole to assemble the tree. Specifications: • Brand: Christow • Dimensions: H180cm x W80cm x D80cm • Colour: Warm White • Material: Metal • Lights: Pre-lit • Tree shape: Full • Weight: 2.6kg For decorative use only. Not a toy. Ensure the tree is securely assembled and positioned on a stable surface. Keep away from heat and naked flames. Read and follow all instructions and safety warnings before use. Wilton Bradley Ltd, 8 Wentworth Road, Heathfield Industrial Estate, Newton Abbot, Devon, TQ12 6TL

wpy8e5e6.baseName: My Christmas Large Bow Christmas Tree Décor with Warm LED Lights - Gold
wpy8e5e6.variantName: My Christmas Large Bow Christmas Tree Décor with Warm LED Lights - Gold
wpy8e5e6.sourceDescription: Add a festive finishing touch to your Christmas decorations with this LED-lit Christmas tree bow topper. The large double-layered bow features a decorative woven design with a retro-inspired appearance and is made from durable polyester with a PVC backing. Lightweight and easy to decorate, it can be securely placed on Christmas trees without weighing down or deforming the branches. The integrated LED lights provide a warm glow and are battery operated, making the bow suitable for evening displays. It can also be used to decorate doors, fireplaces, shopping malls, Christmas parties, carnivals and other festive spaces. Specifications: Double-layered woven bow design made from polyester with a PVC backing. Features integrated LED lighting and is powered by 2 batteries (not included). Lightweight and suitable for a range of indoor Christmas decorations. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

vfwbenxe.sourceDescription: Finish Festive Trees with a Tree Skirt Add a practical decorative feature to the home with this christmas tree skirt. Its soft decorative tree-base cover helps create a tidy finishing layer around a Christmas tree while giving the surrounding space a considered finish. The design is easy to position within an appropriate setting, making it useful for refreshing an existing arrangement without changing permanent fixtures or furniture. Use it as part of a focused seasonal display or coordinated room scheme to add personality and a clear decorative detail. Key Benefits • The soft decorative tree-base cover gives the piece a distinctive finish • Helps create a tidy finishing layer around a Christmas tree • Offers a simple way to refresh an existing display • Works as a practical feature and decorative accent Dimensions: D90cm Material: 100% Polyester Care Instructions: Machine washable at 30°C. Do not bleach, iron, tumble dry, or dry clean. Keep away from fire. Online Home Shop, Priestley Road, Manchester, M28 2LX
